_comment: Your live ad inventory. Set sold:true and fill the fields to run a campaign. Unsold slots automatically render a 'your ad here' house ad pointing at /advertise — which is how you sell the next one.

sidebar._note: house:true means we are running our own promotion here. It renders labelled as the publisher's own, and the rate card still shows the slot as AVAILABLE — marking it Booked would tell a prospective advertiser the inventory is taken when it is not.
sidebar.headline: A complete website for your contracting business
sidebar.body: Three to five pages, custom design, mobile, contact form, launch included. Three days, $750 once.
